title: 单日数据看着弱：9到10月合并却是稳定，4.6%基线还守不守？
speaker: UBS APAC Global Research Head (name not stated)

segments.en: Many questions. Okay, let me sum it up in cue points, right?
segments.zh: 很多问题。好，我按要点总结一下，好吗？

segments.en: I think firstly, in terms of the macro data, let's not just take yesterday or one single data, you know, following a view.
segments.zh: 我认为首先，就宏观数据而言，我们不能只看昨天或单一数据就形成观点。

segments.en: I think that trajectory, if you look at the past quarter from September leading October, the whole trend is leading to a moderate stability, you know, in terms of the China macro,
segments.zh: 我认为这个轨迹，如果看过去一个季度从九月到十月，整个趋势是走向温和稳定，就内地宏观而言，

segments.en: which is kind of the expectation it is. So we are still confident.
segments.zh: 这符合预期。所以我们仍有信心。

segments.en: I'll show you that because the data seems to be showing the opposite.
segments.zh: 我会展示给你看，因为数据似乎显示相反。

segments.en: I think if you look at the combination of September October, this is actually a case of stability.
segments.zh: 我认为如果看九月和十月的组合，这实际上是稳定的情况。

segments.en: Let's not single out yesterday. Yes.
segments.zh: 我们不要单挑昨天。是的。

segments.en: I'm just starting to get the data to which you're reporting. Yeah, exactly.
segments.zh: 我只是开始获取你提到的数据。是的，没错。

segments.en: So I think over, if you look at the China growth, 4.6% is still a baseline forecast for the rest of this year.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，如果看中国增长，4.6%仍是今年剩余时间的基线预测。

segments.en: Okay, so I think that answered the first question about macro, right?
segments.zh: 好，我认为这回答了关于宏观的第一个问题，对吧？

segments.en: So leading to the market strategy. So we always like a barbell strategy.
segments.zh: 所以引向市场策略。我们总是喜欢杠铃策略。

segments.en: On the defensive side, financials, let's give you like, you know, income, you know, so I think that is already performing.
segments.zh: 防御端，金融板块，提供收益，我认为这已经在表现。

segments.en: Right? So then you have an option of the tech growth, like being the tech hardware, you know, the AI, you know, the optics leading to moving back to my earlier point about,
segments.zh: 对吧？然后你有科技成长的选择，比如科技硬件、AI、光学，回到我早先的观点，

segments.en: if you look beyond the near-term turbulence, going back, you know, to the self-reliance mode, this is going to drive your growth, you know, into,
segments.zh: 如果你看穿近期波动，回到自给自足模式，这将驱动增长，

segments.en: you know, into next year and the year after.
